how-19-01-compare.page: Drag the paper-towel strip under one tray and the dark paper under the other, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Turn on sun and water. Then swap them and press it again.
how-19-01-compare.say: Drag the paper-towel strip under one tray and the dark paper under the other, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Turn on sun and water. Then swap them and press it again.

how-19-01-partc.page: Draw a before and after: one plant in bright sunlight and one plant kept in the dark. Under each one, write what you see. Name at least 3 differences in all.
